decoder.yolo_t.name: YOLOv8/v9/v11/v12 (4+C layout)
decoder.yolo_t.desc: Output [4+classes, candidates] (or transposed): 4 box numbers (center and size) followed by one score per class, no objectness. ultralytics exports of YOLOv8, YOLOv9, YOLO11 and YOLO12 use this layout.
decoder.yolo_flat.name: YOLOv5/v7/v6 (with objectness)
decoder.yolo_flat.desc: Output [candidates, 5+classes]: center and size, objectness, one score per class; final score = objectness x class score. For YOLOv5, YOLOv7, YOLOv6 and already-decoded YOLOX.
decoder.yolox_raw.name: YOLOX raw output (not decoded)
decoder.yolox_raw.desc: The official YOLOX ONNX without decoding: box positions are grid offsets and sizes are log values, so they are converted back with strides 8/16/32.
decoder.end2end.name: Output with NMS included (YOLOv10, etc.)
decoder.end2end.desc: Output [boxes, 6 or 7]: the final boxes, scores and classes. For YOLOv10 and YOLOv5/v7/v8 exported with NMS built in.
decoder.yolo_grid.name: YOLOv2/v3/v4 (grid + anchors)
decoder.yolo_grid.desc: Outputs are one or more grid feature maps; anchors are needed to recover boxes. For YOLOv2 (including tiny and K210 kmodel), YOLOv3, YOLOv4 and their tiny versions.
decoder.tflite_ssd.name: TFLite SSD (MobileNet detection)
decoder.tflite_ssd.desc: 4 outputs: boxes, classes, scores, count; NMS is already done inside the model. For the TensorFlow Lite SSD MobileNet object detection sample models.
decoder.reason.yolo_t_cf: Output {shape}: {d} = 4 coordinates + {c} classes, the YOLOv8-and-later format (v8, v9, v11, v12)
decoder.reason.yolo_t_tr: Output {shape}: last axis {d} = 4 coordinates + {c} classes (transposed), the YOLOv8-and-later format
decoder.reason.yolo_flat: Output {shape}: {d} = 5 + {c} classes (4 coordinates + 1 objectness), possibly YOLOv5/v6/v7
decoder.reason.yolo_flat_v5: Output {shape}: {d} = 5 + {c} classes, {n} = 3 x grid cells {grid} (input {size}), the YOLOv5/YOLOv7 format
decoder.reason.yolo_flat_v6: Output {shape}: {d} = 5 + {c} classes, {n} = grid cells (input {size}) and the coordinates look decoded already: YOLOv6 or decoded YOLOX
decoder.reason.yolox_raw: Output {shape}: {d} = 5 + {c} classes, {n} = grid cells (input {size}) and the coordinates look undecoded: the official raw YOLOX format
decoder.reason.end2end: Output {shape}: {d} numbers per row (box, score, class) with few rows, so NMS is already done (YOLOv10-style format)
decoder.reason.yolo_grid: Output {shapes}: {n_out} grid feature map(s) (smallest {hw}), {a} anchors per cell and {c} classes, the YOLOv2/v3/v4 grid format
decoder.reason.yolo_grid_guess: The anchors are a guess ({preset}). If boxes are in the wrong place or size, set the correct anchors in the model card.
decoder.reason.tflite_ssd: Output {shapes}: boxes [1, N, 4] plus classes, scores and count, the TFLite SSD detection format
decoder.err.class_mismatch: The model outputs {model} classes, but the label file has {labels} names.
decoder.err.class_mismatch_hint: Check that the label file (labels.txt) belongs to this model; the number of names must equal the model's number of classes.
decoder.err.bad_shape: The model output shape {shape} does not fit the "{kind}" decoder.
decoder.err.bad_shape_hint: Pick another output format (decoder) in the model panel, or check which YOLO version the model was exported from.
decoder.err.grid_mismatch: The model gave {n} candidates, but the input size {size} does not produce that many grid cells.
decoder.err.grid_mismatch_hint: Check that the input size matches the model, or set strides in decoder_params of the model card.
decoder.err.columns: columns has {got} entries but each model output row has {need} numbers.
decoder.err.anchors_odd: The number of anchor values must be even (width and height pairs).
decoder.err.anchors_hint: Set anchors in decoder_params of the model card, or choose a built-in set with anchors_preset.
decoder.err.preset: There is no built-in anchor set called "{name}". Available: {names}.
decoder.err.anchor_count: This output has {a} anchors per cell, but only {m} were given.
